interventions.what: text screen and BIOS data area (0040:0049, 0040:006C) read from DOSBox-X savestates (Host+S; components Vga and Memory)
a savestate is written at each read, and one is loaded (Host+L) at the start and at the reset (vocabulary/interventions.md lists save and load of state as I2; neutrality not tested)

start_state.restore: fresh DOSBox-X process (config sha256 f72763578785006a29212eabe63e7f286a3832b6311cc8705ce63f840d3ce076) with C: mounted from the folder the savestate was made with, recreated from the verified release copy; GOAL run to its title screen; key n to change the screen; then Host+L (host key F12+L) loads the savestate whose sha256 is given; polled until the screen digest equals the one stored with it (cd7f15fbf853b40471d05bad51cb6e6c14cbc8a7307893dba8f5f36c2315c612); host clock and seed not controlled
